reference_sql:
WITH current_prices AS (
  SELECT product_id, list_price_eur
  FROM price_history
  WHERE valid_to IS NULL
    AND list_price_eur > 400
),
check_shares AS (
  SELECT cp.product_id, AVG(CASE WHEN cp.price_eur < c.list_price_eur THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS share_below
  FROM competitor_prices cp
  JOIN current_prices c ON c.product_id = cp.product_id
  GROUP BY cp.product_id
),
product_units AS (
  SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS units
  FROM order_lines
  GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT s.product_id, COALESCE(u.units, 0) AS units, c.list_price_eur, s.share_below
FROM check_shares s
JOIN current_prices c ON c.product_id = s.product_id
LEFT JOIN product_units u ON u.product_id = s.product_id

solver.query:
WITH cur AS (
  SELECT product_id, list_price_eur
  FROM price_history
  WHERE valid_to IS NULL AND list_price_eur > 400
), product_units AS (
  SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS units
  FROM order_lines
  GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT cur.product_id,
       COALESCE(pu.units, 0) AS units,
       cur.list_price_eur,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN cp.price_eur < cur.list_price_eur THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS share_below
FROM cur
JOIN competitor_prices cp ON cp.product_id = cur.product_id
LEFT JOIN product_units pu ON pu.product_id = cur.product_id
GROUP BY cur.product_id, pu.units, cur.list_price_eur
